6.3.rationale: The original Indonesian text explicitly addresses women workers. Pasal 7(3) states: "Pihak yang mempekerjakan tenaga kerja perempuan, wajib memberikan perlindungan sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku" and Pasal 7(4) says it will be further regulated by Peraturan Bupati. Additionally Pasal 28(b) requires employers using female workers to provide protection including "kesejahteraan, keselamatan dan kesehatan." These provisions are directly about women workers and protections in employment. The retrieved English candidates include these points, and the judge’s conclusion is consistent with the Indonesian source. Therefore the golden label 'No' appears incorrect.
